import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import sys
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
sys.stdout.reconfigure(line_buffering=True)

# Paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/ru_train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/ru_test.csv"
SAMPLE_PATH = "./input/ru_sample_submission.csv"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)
SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

print("Loading data...", flush=True)
try:
    train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
    test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
    sample_df = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_PATH)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("Falling back to alternate filenames...", flush=True)
    train_df = pd.read_csv(
        "./input/ru_train_2.csv"
        if os.path.exists("./input/ru_train_2.csv")
        else TRAIN_PATH
    )
    test_df = pd.read_csv(
        "./input/ru_test_2.csv"
        if os.path.exists("./input/ru_test_2.csv")
        else TEST_PATH
    )
    sample_df = pd.read_csv(
        "./input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv"
        if os.path.exists("./input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv")
        else SAMPLE_PATH
    )

# Clean inputs
for df in [train_df, test_df]:
    df["before"] = df["before"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
if "after" in train_df.columns:
    train_df["after"] = train_df["after"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()

print("Building case-pooled lookup table...", flush=True)
# Pool counts by lowercase 'before' to aggregate frequencies across capitalization variants
train_df["before_lower"] = train_df["before"].str.lower()
counts = train_df.groupby(["before_lower", "after"]).size().reset_index(name="cnt")
mode_rows = counts.loc[counts.groupby("before_lower")["cnt"].idxmax()]
norm_lookup = mode_rows.set_index("before_lower")["after"].to_dict()


def predict_token(token):
    t = token.strip()
    if not t:
        return t
    # Case-pooled lookup
    pred = norm_lookup.get(t.lower())
    if pred is not None:
        return pred
    # Deterministic tie-break: prefer shorter normalized form if multiple exist (handled by idxmax deterministically)
    # Fallback for OOV: return original token to prevent hallucination
    return t


print("Generating test predictions...", flush=True)
test_preds = test_df["before"].apply(predict_token).values

# Construct submission ID safely
if "sentence_id" in test_df.columns and "token_id" in test_df.columns:
    test_ids = (
        test_df["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + test_df["token_id"].astype(str)
    )
else:
    # Fallback if ids are already in an 'id' column
    test_ids = test_df["id"]

final_sub = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "after": test_preds})
# Ensure order matches sample submission
if len(sample_df) == len(final_sub):
    final_sub = final_sub.set_index("id").reindex(sample_df["id"]).reset_index()
else:
    print(
        f"Warning: Submission row count mismatch ({len(final_sub)} vs {len(sample_df)}). Using generated order.",
        flush=True,
    )

final_sub.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_PATH}", flush=True)

# Validation on strict sentence-level hold-out
print("Running validation...", flush=True)
np.random.seed(42)
sentences = train_df["sentence_id"].unique()
n_val_sents = max(1, int(0.05 * len(sentences)))
val_sents = np.random.choice(sentences, size=n_val_sents, replace=False)
val_mask = train_df["sentence_id"].isin(val_sents)
train_holdout = train_df[~val_mask]

# Rebuild lookup strictly on holdout training data
val_counts = (
    train_holdout.groupby(["before_lower", "after"]).size().reset_index(name="cnt")
)
val_mode_rows = val_counts.loc[val_counts.groupby("before_lower")["cnt"].idxmax()]
val_lookup = val_mode_rows.set_index("before_lower")["after"].to_dict()

val_data = train_df.loc[val_mask].copy()
val_preds = val_data["before"].apply(lambda x: val_lookup.get(x.lower(), x)).values
val_true = val_data["after"].values

acc = np.mean(val_preds == val_true)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {acc:.4f}", flush=True)
